CVE-2026-118666.title: GraphQL Tools: Shared legacy executor routes one subscription's results to a different caller
CVE-2026-118666.description: GraphQL Tools provides utilities for building, stitching, and mocking GraphQL schemas. CVE-2026-125338.title: Winter CMS: Stored XSS through cached Brand Settings and Editor Settings custom styles
CVE-2026-125338.description: Winter CMS is a content management system built on the Laravel PHP framework. CVE-2026-55444.title: Goobi viewer: Solr query injection via the legacy RSS servlet q and filterQuery parameters
CVE-2026-55444.description: The Goobi viewer is a web application that allows digitised material to be displayed in a web browser. Prior to version 26.05, the legacy RSS servlet (RssResolver, GET /rss/) accepts the q and filterQuery parameters and concatenates them into Solr queries without validation. The servlet predates the REST API layer and lacks the input validation present in GET /api/v1/records/rss. q forms the main query body (wrapped only in literal parentheses); filterQuery is passed directly as a Solr fq. An unauthenticated attacker can inject Solr boolean operators to break out of the wrapping and render the trailing access-condition filter-query suffix optional, so that access-restricted records are included in the generated RSS feed. The q and filterQuery parameters are the same underlying vulnerability in the same servlet; q (the main query body) has the broader scope. This issue has been patched in version 26.05.

CVE-2026-85737.title: Velociraptor: Low-priv analyst reads arbitrary server files via ungated sql() VQL plugin
CVE-2026-85737.description: Velociraptor is a tool for collecting host-based state information using Velociraptor Query Language (VQL) queries. CVE-2026-99123.title: vsock/virtio: validate packet source for connected sockets
CVE-2026-99123.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

vsock/virtio: validate packet source for connected sockets

virtio_transport_recv_pkt() looks up sockets first by the full source and
destination tuple, then by destination only in the bound table. The
fallback is needed for listening and connecting sockets, but sockets remain
in the bound table after connect(), so it can also return a non-listening
socket.

The fallback does not validate the source address. In TCP_SYN_SENT, a
RESPONSE from an unrelated source can transition the victim socket to
TCP_ESTABLISHED while its stored remote address remains unchanged.
Subsequent RW packets from that source are delivered through the same
destination-only fallback.

This was reproduced with capability-empty processes under different UIDs.

sock_diag and caused the victim socket to read 16 attacker-chosen bytes;

CVE-2026-99422.title: ovl: use the pinned upper dir in ovl_fix_origin()
CVE-2026-99422.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ovl: use the pinned upper dir in ovl_fix_origin()

Renames made directly on the upper filesystem during a lookup crash the
kernel.

A dentry that is passed to vfs_setxattr() must be pinned.
ovl_fix_origin() passes upper->d_parent to ovl_set_impure() without a
reference, and the lookup holds no lock of the upper directory. A
rename on the upper filesystem changes d_parent, and only the child
pins the new parent, so a second rename and an rmdir free it.

With delays in ovl_fix_origin() and ovl_set_impure(), renaming the upper
directory twice and removing the intermediate parent during the lookup
of a merge directory without an origin xattr gave a KASAN
use-after-free in vfs_setxattr().

Fix this by passing the upper dentry that the overlay parent holds.

[amir: add helper ovl_set_impure_dir()]

CVE-2026-99747.title: ksmbd: fix NULL pointer dereference in session_user_name() and session_account_type()
CVE-2026-99747.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: fix NULL pointer dereference in session_user_name() and session_account_type()

session_user_name() and session_account_type() dereference
session->user without checking for NULL. A session can be published
and exposed via the procfs session interface before authentication
completes, during which session->user is NULL:

show_proc_session() -> session_user_name(sess)
-> user_guest(session->user) -> NULL->flags -> oops

Guard both functions by treating a NULL session->user as an explicit
not-yet-authenticated state rather than dereferencing it.

CVE-2026-99804.title: io_uring/io-wq: save worker type before dropping its reference
CVE-2026-99804.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

io_uring/io-wq: save worker type before dropping its reference

io_wq_cancel_tw_create() inspects cb->func after calling
io_worker_cancel_cb(). For an existing worker, that call can drop the
last worker reference and wake io_worker_exit(). If the canceling task
is preempted, the worker can be unlinked and freed by kfree_rcu() before
the callback function is inspected. KASAN reports a slab-use-after-free
read in this path.

Save whether the callback belongs to an unpublished continuation worker
while its reference is still held, then use the saved result for the
conditional free. This preserves the existing accounting and frees only
the worker allocated for the canceled continuation.
